## Personality

Jane is a steady, sensible, and practical individual who is known for her nice, lady-like demeanor and a personal fondness for the woods. Driven by a desire for financial independence, she intends to devote her life to teaching rather than marriage, aiming to earn her salary fairly, satisfy the school trustees, and achieve a place on the School Inspector's roll of honor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v2 IV Different Opinions P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 IV Different Opinions P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P76](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0076), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## History

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) attended school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), visiting an [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) with Ruby on multiple occasions. While studying in town, Jane visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house along with [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) and Ruby, sharing news of the Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Later, she joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a springtime walk into the woods to celebrate Anne's unofficial birthday, during which they explored the forgotten garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) and shared conversations about nature over lunch.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P13](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P1](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P2](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P8](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P10](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0010), +238 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are long-time friends and companions. Jane visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to help ease her homesickness when she moved to town to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), sharing news that helped spark Anne's ambition. Their bond endures into adulthood, with Jane joining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on special social outings, such as a springtime walk to celebrate Anne's unofficial birthday.

- Friend of — friends and companions  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII.
